way_names_note: 2026-11-23, from the 2025-26 trail maps: Subway and the green pieces from the Meadow chair top are the beginner areas; the unnamed blue track from the Treeline Cirque mid-station to the Lakeview chair is To Lakeview, its last piece through Scott Meadow (OpenStreetMap wetland) is Scott Meadow; the second Sunnyside way from the Wa She Shu top to the Siberia base is the map's 'to Mountain Run'; the green track OpenStreetMap calls Bailey's, from the Gold Coast Express top east, is The Mora; Adam's Rib, between Montezuma's and Strainer under Snow King, is the map's Costello's (moderate confidence).
split_ways_note: 2026-11-23: OpenStreetMap maps East Runout and Sandy's Corner as one way (name Sandy's Corner, piste:name East Runout); the Alpine Meadows map puts East Runout on the upper part and Sandy's Corner by the base, so the way is cut a little below half way. West Face Alternates (248622080), the unlisted OpenStreetMap line from the Nose down the lower west face of KT-22, is the map's Nose Chutes above and its 5th below (fall lines from both trail-map labels run along it), so it is cut where the 5th label falls on it instead of drawing a second line beside it.
